datasource.description: Datasource the statement runs on; required even when only one is configured

sql.description: One statement, run as it is and auto-committed: not parsed, rewritten or masked

args.description: Positional parameters, in the dialect's placeholder style ($1 for PostgreSQL, ? for MySQL and OceanBase)

mode.description: query returns columns and rows; exec returns rowsAffected (DML, DDL, SET)
